text:
Anjali Patel: Quick heads-up — we're tightening the SDK output contract for v4.1. Short summary:
- JSON normalization enforced (no trailing commas, deterministic key ordering for 'metadata').
- parse_mode default changes from `auto` -> `strict` for parse_json.
- SDKs will start emitting a deprecation warning today; enforcement timeline: SDKs enforce in 60 days, hosted API enforcement in 120 days (grace windows differ to give customers time).
Migration guide (draft): https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk-output-migration :link:
Opt-in example to strict behavior:```python
client = RedwoodClient(parse_json='strict')
```
We'll also publish a migration checklist and a small compatibility shim for common prompt patterns. Please review and shout if you see blockers. :megaphone:

Samir Khan: For Dedicated customers — will their infra auto-upgrade or do they need to apply changes?

Anjali Patel: Good q — Dedicated does NOT auto-upgrade. We'll ship an SDK compatibility patch and a separate Dedicated rollout plan (ops-led). We'll provide a one-click package for Private/Dedicated admins, plus a config flag to preserve legacy behavior for another 90 days if they need it.

Maria Gomez: Will this affect model outputs used in our evals? I worry about false positives in regression alerts.

Anjali Patel: Yes it can. We're coordinating with Optimize: evals tied to SDK-parsed fields will receive an automatic normalization step so historical evals compare apples-to-apples. We'll add a toggle on the regression alert to ignore normalization diffs for 30 days.

Tara Liu: Any breaking examples we can post in the guide? A lot of customers rely on loose JSON from models.

Anjali Patel: Added two real-world examples in the draft: trailing commas causing parse passes previously, and maps with non-deterministic key order. The checklist includes how to reformat prompts and a few lightweight prompt-hardeners.

Kyle Reardon: Timeline for external comms? We should coordinate with marketing/support so we don't flood customers unexpectedly.

Anjali Patel: Plan: internal announcement (this thread + product-all) today; targeted emails to high-usage customers next Wednesday; public docs + migration guide + changelog entry at release time. We'll also include a short FAQ and sample migration PR for popular SDK languages.

Samir Khan: Can we get a small telemetry event so we can track how many apps rely on legacy parsing?

Anjali Patel: Yes — eng-runtime will add a non-identifying telemetry ping when deprecated parse_mode is encountered. It will be opt-out for Dedicated/Private.

DocsBot: Migration draft + checklist PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 (commented with TODOs for language-specific snippets). Also added a quick diff showing changed examples.

Maria Gomez: Thx — I'll add a pair of integration tests to the eval harness to detect regressions early.

Tara Liu: Engineering action item: add a runtime warning log with link to guide. Who picks this up?

Anjali Patel: Eng-runtime: @Tara Liu to own the warning + telemetry. Docs: @Maria Gomez & @Anjali Patel to finalise migration examples by Friday. Product/Kyle to draft customer comms.

Kyle Reardon: Ack. I'll sync with growth for the comms cadence.

Anjali Patel: Final note — if you're maintaining SDK samples or tutorials, please update them this week. We'll add a short compatibility paragraph on top of affected guides. Thanks all. :pray:
